Turning this on sticks. Turning it off does not — the order the app was built with wins, so an old publish can never put the game back in front of the film. Ask M if a day really needs the game first.

Something she is actually given, hung off this day. The food ones are hers — chips, soup, biryani, nihari, avocado — and the rest are afternoons rather than objects.

this gift
These words belong to the gift, not to the day — rewrite them and every day that hands her this gift says the new version.
Everything on this pane happens once — the first time she opens the day. If she comes back to it later, or lives the day again from the envelope, none of it fires. A joke told twice is just a bug.
Every film, in the order she will see them. Tap ▶ to watch one full screen, mark it, and write yourself a note. The marks stay on this phone.

Say it out loud instead. It sits under the letter, with a play button — it never starts on its own, and if it fails to load she never finds out there was one.

Her site is a public repo, so a voice note in it can be downloaded by anyone who has the address. Nobody has the address. But that is the deal — same as the music.

2. A word only you two know:
